correctness.rationale: For graph K1 joined to m disjoint r-cliques, r>=2 fixed, hub-t fiber of fractional edge relaxation factorizes over blocks. Below t=1/2, partition leaf cube into all-small and exactly-one-large coordinate regions: b_r(t)=2^(1-r)-t^r; above t=1/2, b_r(t)=(1-t)^r. Fractional volume is ∫0^(1/2)(c-t^r)^m dt+2^(-rm-1)/(rm+1). Integral stable-set fiber is m r-simplexes (1-t)^r/r!, total 1/(r!^m(rm+1)). Dominated convergence after u=m^(1/r)t gives fractional volume ~c^m c^(1/r)Gamma(1+1/r)m^(-1/r), normalized hub law exp(-u^r/c), and ratio ~ (r!c)^m*r*c^(1/r)Gamma(1+1/r)*m^(1-1/r). Integral hub scaled by (rm+1) tends exponential. r=2 gives sqrt(pi m/2) and half-normal. Independently checked several finite quadratures, exact r2 and small m formulas and limiting constants; no finite check substituted for dominated convergence.
